hypotheses.B0_reverse_ce_derivative_matches_forward: The reverse-mode local-write CE gradient reproduces an independent forward-mode exact CE directional derivative to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.B1_ce_aware_64_mode_program_is_sufficien: A fixed 64-mode CE-aware selection retains at least 0.90 CE directional-derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B2_ce_aware_selection_beats_energy_prefi: At 64 modes, CE-aware selection exceeds the local-Frobenius energy prefix by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B3_ce_aware_128_mode_program_is_high_fid: A fixed 128-mode CE-aware selection retains at least 0.95 CE derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B4_ce_aware_selection_transfers_ood: At 64 modes, each OOD fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.B5_ce_aware_selection_beats_random: At 64 modes, the selected bank exceeds the random-bank 95th percentile by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B6_top256_local_modes_cover_loss: All 256 local spectral modes retain at least 0.98 CE derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B7_loss_relevance_reorders_local_energy_: Fewer than half of the CE-aware top 64 modes are in the local-energy top 64.
